clients.name: Google Antigravity
clients.integrationMechanism: MCP stdio + CLI workspace execution + Reusable Skills
clients.testEvidence: Tested via StdioClientTransport integration test (tests/mcp.integration.test.ts) and Antigravity workspace terminal execution.
clients.limitations: Native Wasp CLI execution requires WSL when running inside Windows host workspaces.

clients.name: Claude Code / Claude Desktop
clients.testEvidence: Verified with official @modelcontextprotocol/sdk client (tests/mcp.integration.test.ts) with zero stdout pollution.
clients.limitations: Desktop app cannot directly invoke interactive CLI prompts; must use MCP tool calls.

clients.name: Cursor
clients.integrationMechanism: Cursor Settings -> Features -> MCP Server (command transport)
clients.testEvidence: Protocol compliance and tool registration confirmed via StdioClientTransport tests.
clients.limitations: Cursor agent mode invokes tools autonomously; long-running Wasp compiler commands must respect Cursor command timeout.

clients.name: OpenCode
clients.integrationMechanism: MCP stdio server and direct CLI execution
accessibleFeatures: Direct CLI execution ('forge create', 'forge wasp', 'forge rea')
clients.testEvidence: CLI argument forwarding and exit code propagation verified in tests/upstreamDelegation.test.ts.
clients.limitations: Requires Node.js >= 22.0.0 on the user machine.

clients.name: VS Code / GitHub Copilot
clients.integrationMechanism: VS Code Task / Extension Terminal execution + experimental MCP extension
clients.testEvidence: Direct CLI execution tested and verified with standard process spawning.
clients.limitations: Copilot Chat native MCP support is in preview/staged rollout across VS Code versions.

clients.name: Cline (VS Code Extension)
accessibleFeatures: All 6 Forge MCP tools including REA and Wasp delegation
Automated workspace synthesis and verifier loops
clients.testEvidence: Standard MCP JSON-RPC protocol compliance verified against schema standards.
clients.limitations: File creation permissions depend on Cline's user-approval settings.

clients.name: Roo Code (Roo Clinic)
clients.testEvidence: Verified compatible with standard MCP 1.6+ protocol schemas.
clients.limitations: Requires user approval for file overwriting outside active workspace.

clients.name: Windsurf (Codeium Cascade)
accessibleFeatures: Cascade tool invocation and contextual code generation
clients.limitations: Windsurf environment variables must pass current Node PATH.

clients.name: Gemini CLI
clients.integrationMechanism: Direct CLI execution + JSON output parsing
clients.testEvidence: Tested via CLI commands and subprocess JSON stdout parsing.
clients.limitations: Gemini CLI lacks native background stdio MCP daemon; relies on CLI execution.

clients.name: Codex CLI
clients.integrationMechanism: Direct CLI execution and script invocation
clients.testEvidence: Verified CLI exit codes, stdout framing, and error streams.
clients.limitations: Terminal execution requires non-interactive options where supported.
